infos.title: Additional information
infos.totalPrepTimeDescription: This takes the recipe into account

helper.title: Mix water, yeast and honey
descriptions: Weigh all the ingredients.
In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in the water and add the honey.

helper.title: Add the flour
descriptions: Add the flour gradually, mixing with a wooden spoon until you get a homogeneous mixture

steps.title: Rest { rtRestTime } hour(s) at room temperature

helper.title: Rest at room temperature
descriptions: Let rest { rtRestTime } hour(s) at room temperature in an airtight container or covered with plastic wrap

steps.title: Rest { coldRestTime } hour(s) in the refrigerator

helper.title: Rest in the refrigerator
descriptions: Let rest { coldRestTime } hour(s) in the refrigerator in an airtight container or covered with plastic wrap

steps.title: Take out the poolish 1H before use

helper.title: How to use the poolish
descriptions: Take out the poolish 1 hour before use, so that it has time to return to room temperature

steps.title: In the poolish, add the water and salt

helper.title: Dough preparation
descriptions: Weigh the quantities to be added to the poolish
In the poolish bowl, add the water and salt. Mix with a wooden spoon until the water is absorbed

steps.title: Add the flour little by little

helper.title: How to add the flour
descriptions: Add the flour little by little and mix with a wooden spoon

steps.title: Transfer the dough to the work surface

helper.title: Dough transfer
descriptions: When it's no longer possible to mix with the spoon, you start to have a dough appearance and you can transfer it to the work surface
Use a pastry scraper to help with the transfer

helper.title: Kneading
descriptions: Work the dough by kneading it, the flour must be completely integrated
Use the palm of your hands to knead

steps.title: Make a few folds and form a ball

helper.title: Folds
descriptions: To make a fold, take the dough and fold it on itself
You can make as many folds as you want, but the dough must remain soft and supple
The fold allows air to be introduced into the dough and will allow an airy texture when baking
Once finished, you can form a beautiful ball

helper.title: Rest
descriptions: Simply turn over the bowl used for preparation on the dough
The dough will tighten and become smoother

helper.title: Reform a ball
descriptions: Don't work the dough too much
Stretch the dough and by making it turn a few times between your hands, reform a ball

helper.title: Forming the dough balls
descriptions: Take the dough and with the help of a dough cutter or a spatula
Form dough balls (well stretched) of about { pizzaWeight } g
Put a thin layer of fine semolina in a dish (this will prevent them from sticking to the dish)
Place the dough balls in a dish leaving space between them (they will still grow)
Close the dish or put plastic wrap

helper.title: Dough ball rest
descriptions: The resting time of the dough ball varies depending on the temperature
It takes about { rtRestTime } hour(s), so remember to take it into account 😉

helper.title: Dough preparation
descriptions: Weigh all the ingredients
Mix the yeast and honey with the water

helper.title: Introduction of the flour
descriptions: Add the salt and flour little by little and mix with a wooden spoon until you get a homogeneous mixture

helper.title: Kneading
descriptions: Once all the ingredients are well mixed and you start to have a dough, you can place it on the work surface
You can use a pastry scraper to recover all the dough
Finish kneading by hand for about 10 min. Knead well with the palm of your hands to properly hydrate the flour
You can also use a stand mixer with its dough hook, but it's less fun 😉

helper.title: Dough ball
descriptions: Once the dough has a beautiful structure, stretch the dough and by making it turn a few times between your hands, form a ball

helper.title: Rest
descriptions: Simply turn over the bowl used for preparation on the dough
The dough will tighten and become smoother
